title: Jantjies puts Hopetown on the map as Steyn makes history — Two Oceans Marathon
claims: The 2026 Totalsports Two Oceans Ultra Marathon was held on Saturday 11 April 2026.
Arthur Jantjies won the men's 56 km in 3:09:25.
Gerda Steyn won the women's 56 km in 3:27:43, her record-breaking seventh victory.
The official report says Jantjies won by 35 seconds over Khonkhobe.
The official report calls Steyn's 3:27:43 the second fastest Two Oceans time of her career and lists her 3:26:54 as the fastest women's time in race history.
The 2026 combined prize purse was ZAR 2.6 million; the Ultra carried ZAR 2,177,400 and the Half Marathon ZAR 422,600.

verification.note: Official race report read in full on 2026-11-20. It gives the winners, Jantjies' 35-second margin, Steyn's 3:27:43 and 3:26:54 history, and the 2026 prize-purse split.
